title: AI-guided reactor design improves a specific continuous-flow cycloaddition
summary: Reac-Discovery combines learned geometry screening with automated experimental optimization of continuous-flow catalytic reactors. The peer-reviewed article reports a Schoen_G structured reactor with space–time yield of 803 g L−1 h−1 for a specific CO₂–epichlorohydrin cycloaddition, compared with 412 in the study’s initial data set. The comparison is study-specific and restricted to the authors’ reactor conditions; it does not establish industrial scale or net carbon removal. The article was published online on 13 October 2025; an earlier preprint described the platform and reaction, so this record attributes the 803 result to the journal version.
ai_technology: Neural geometry screening and machine-learning-guided experimental optimization
